integrity: Self-contained proof, standalone exact finite-field checker, and captured output; finite verification is corroborative rather than proof; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only point-only ternary collinearity, ordinary counting-free FO, and existing finite affine/projective planes of order >=2. 5-variable statement compares affine versus projective planes that already coincide at width 4; does not classify all FO5 theories. Uninspected 1998 collinearity-modal report leaves historical priority risk.
title: Three collinearity theories of finite affine and projective planes at four variables
